chunks.spoken: You can't read your users' chats. So logless sends an agent that writes and runs code, sandboxed on Vultr.

chunks.caption: 5,000 real chats, grouped by GLM on Vultr.
chunks.spoken: Five thousand real chats, grouped by G L M on Vultr.

chunks.caption: TypeSafe Jev routes each live, about {rate} a second.
chunks.spoken: TypeSafe Jev routes each live, about {rate} a second.

chunks.caption: Privacy gate passes; the map republishes.

chunks.caption: Coding: under a fifth of chats, over a quarter of friction.
chunks.spoken: Coding: under a fifth of chats, over a quarter of friction.

chunks.caption: The agent plans, then writes two independent programs without seeing a row.
